services.name: Kids Karate
services.desc: A welcoming martial arts class for kids ages 5 and up-where steady practice builds focus, respect, coordination, and confidence one class at a time. For Westminster families, the first question is usually not whether a child can throw a kick. It is whether they will feel comfortable enough to keep showing up. At Westy 5280, new kids start with a clear routine, encouraging instructors, and skills broken into steps they can understand. Our American Freestyle Taekwondo program gives kids a real belt path to work toward.
